author: Aguillard, D.P. and others
title: Measurement of the Positive Muon Anomalous Magnetic Moment to 0.20 ppm
abstract: We present a new measurement of the positive muon magnetic anomaly, a_mu, from the Fermilab Muon g-2 Experiment using data collected in 2019 and 2020. ... Combining this result with our previous result from the 2018 data, we obtain a_mu(FNAL) = 116592055(24) x 10^-11 (0.20 ppm). The new experimental world average is a_mu(exp) = 116592059(22) x 10^-11 (0.19 ppm), which represents a factor of 2 improvement in precision.
